description: This file defines a Logger utility class that provides static methods for logging messages at various levels (VERBOSE, DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR, ASSERT). It acts as a wrapper around Android's native Log class and manages a chain of LogNode objects for customized logging behavior.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for different log levels, managing LogNode chaining, and acting as a replacement for android.util.Log.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode chain to the specified node.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Sends the log message to the current LogNode.

methods.name: wtf
methods.description: Logs an assertion failure or critical error.
